audit_md:
## Website Health Check: Villalona Hair Salon

### What we saw on 13 November 2026
- villalonahairsalon.com now shows a parking page: "This domain may be for sale", with no salon name, phone or hours (screenshots at desktop and phone width).
- The Google profile (4.6 from 84 reviews, hair salon, 631 Georges Rd) lists its website as vagaro.com and shows a "Book online" button to the same platform.
- Domain records show one registration from 14 April 2010, renewed to 14 April 2027 at GoDaddy, with nameservers at Above.com, a parking service.
- The Wayback Machine holds their own salon page ("VILLALONA HAIR SALON", (732) 640-2800) from March 2022; by May 2024 the domain already served a parking page.

### What it means for customers
People who search the salon's name or follow an old link reach a for-sale notice instead of the salon. Customers arriving through Google still reach booking normally, so the loss sits with anyone typing the address directly.

### How to fix it
1. Find out who can log in to the GoDaddy account holding the domain (1-2 hrs, owner).
2. If it is still yours, replace the Above.com nameservers with your host's and turn off parking; if not, choose a new domain (1-2 hrs, web person).
3. Put a one-page site on it: name, address, hours, phone, services with prices, stylists, Vagaro booking button (8-20 hrs, web designer).
4. Update the Google profile's website field to your own address (1-2 hrs, owner).
5. Add an uptime and renewal reminder (1 hr).

### After the fix
Publish the service menu and starting prices as text with HairSalon structured data, so search results and AI assistants can answer price questions without opening the booking widget.

Prepared from publicly available information on 13 November 2026. We did not log in to or change anything.

Subject: Your old domain villalonahairsalon.com now shows a "for sale" page

Hi — I was looking up Villalona Hair Salon on Georges Road and noticed that villalonahairsalon.com, which used to be your site, now shows a page that says the domain may be for sale, with no salon information on it. Your Google listing still sends people to Vagaro, so bookings seem unaffected, but anyone who types the old address lands on that notice instead. I have screenshots from a desktop and a phone if you would like to see exactly what customers see, and I can walk you through who to ask about the domain account.
